provenance_note: All client, vendor, and human-contact data excluded. This drawing is predominantly donor names (personal data); only the small technical core survives extraction. Donor copy content is excluded; copy structure is retained as a pattern.

program_model.instance_model: single fabricated design produced as many units; copy varies per unit, fabrication is identical across all units
program_model.rule_demonstrated: Copy-only variants are per-unit instance data, not separate sign records. One design record, N copy instances.

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A small brushed-aluminum donor plaque with digitally printed recognition copy, clear-coated and mounted on a short square post set in a concrete footer, installed at the base of a memorial or donor tree. Produced as a set with identical construction and different donor copy per unit.
knowledge.rationale: Brushed aluminum with a sprayed clear coat is a durable, low-cost outdoor memorial treatment; digital print allows fully variable per-donor copy with no tooling change between units.

structure.construction: 4in x 7in x 1/4in brushed aluminum face panel
structure.decoration: digitally printed copy and client crest, finished with sprayed clear coat

structure.construction: 2in x 1/8in wall aluminum square tube, welded to back of panel
structure.finish_note: callout specifies color P1 (clear coat); rendering reads dark. Minor finish ambiguity flagged.

structure.construction: 8in dia x 18in deep poured concrete footer

materials_manifest.product: digital print, to match standard black

messaging_pattern.layout_rule: copy centered within a 6in maximum copy area with 1/2in side margins; consistent 3/16in interline spacing

rules_observations: Copy constrained to a defined max copy area with equal margins and consistent line spacing, keeping a multi-line memorial message balanced.
craft_observations: Brushed aluminum plus sprayed clear coat is a restrained, durable, dignified treatment appropriate to a commemorative object.

aesthetic_notes.note: Understated and quiet, which is the correct register for memorial and donor recognition.

extraction_meta.field_confidence: high on construction and materials; copy content intentionally excluded as PII

new_application_methods_vocab.source: AGS Color and Finish Key on the drawing
new_application_methods_vocab.note: Clean canonical seed for the decoration/application enum, taken directly from a shop's own finish-key convention.

rules_reinforced: Copy-instance separation: 5 identical plaques with different donor copy = 1 design record + per-unit copy data, not 5 records.
PII exclusion: this is the first drawing that is mostly personal data; the rule correctly reduces it to a small technical core.
schema_strain_log.shape_finding: Did NOT break the record shape. Confirms the fabricated_sign shape generalizes down to small plaques. Does not test the vehicle-wrap shape risk.
